body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes TypeScript build failures caused by treating `NavigationItem.label` (string | i18n object) as a plain string across `plugin-designer` and `components`, by standardizing label rendering through `resolveI18nLabel` exported from `@object-ui/react`.

**Changes:**
- Re-export `resolveI18nLabel` from `@object-ui/react` to unblock downstream imports.
- Update `NavigationDesigner` to resolve labels to strings at all UI/editing usage sites.
- Update `AppCreationWizard` navigation preview to render labels via `resolveI18nLabel`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/react/src/index.ts | Re-exports `resolveI18nLabel` to make label resolution available to other packages. |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/NavigationDesigner.tsx | Uses `resolveI18nLabel` for label draft state + rendering to avoid union-type misuse. |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/AppCreationWizard.tsx | Resolves navigation preview labels via `resolveI18nLabel` to fix ReactNode typing errors. |

Test coverage: the new label resolution path should be exercised with a `NavigationItem.label` i18n object (e.g. `{ key, defaultValue }`) to ensure the designer renders/edits without runtime errors and shows the expected fallback string. Adding a focused test case in `NavigationDesigner.test.tsx` would prevent regressions for this union type.

Test coverage: since the navigation preview now resolves `item.label` via `resolveI18nLabel`, add a test case in `AppCreationWizard.test.tsx` with an i18n-object label to ensure the preview renders the expected fallback string (and doesn’t regress back to TS/ReactNode issues).
